mapper.select: select * from cbs.t_dept where is_using = true
select dept_code from cbs.t_dept where parent_dept_code = #{deptCode} and is_using = true
mapper.insert: insert into cbs.t_dept (dept_code, dept_name, parent_dept_code, is_company, is_using) values (#{d.dept_code}, #{d.dept_name}, #{d.parent_dept_code}, #{d.is_company}, #{d.is_using})
mapper.update: update cbs.t_dept set is_using = false where dept_code = #{deptCode}
update cbs.t_dept set direct_children = nullif(#{subs, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.ArrayTypeHandler}, '{}') where dept_code = #{deptCode} and is_using = true
update cbs.t_dept set recursive_children = nullif(#{subs, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.ArrayTypeHandler}, '{}') where dept_code = #{deptCode} and is_using = true
